name: 役割付きメンバー一覧
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE actual Lighthouse component LH03-0017「役割付きメンバー一覧」.
ORIGINAL Image1 is primary for search glyph, row alignment/proportions, role labels, right chevrons and fine icon details. Mock Image2 secondary for localized contents, type and logical390x238px structure; correct its mint avatars and omitted second-member chevron. Image3 approved white-card styling only.
Header above list: exact「メンバー 2人」MeiryoBold20/28tracking0; at right source-faithful compact magnifying-glass glyph in a quiet white circular search control, subtle neutral outline, slate#526173. No text field.
Below one compact white rounded list card with fine neutral outline and very soft shadow. EXACT TWO rows, no invented members:
row1: white40px circular avatar with fine neutral outline and forestgreen「あ」; name「あなた」; below「連絡できます」; right quiet「管理者」. No right chevron on YOUR own row, matching source.
row2: white40px outlined avatar with forestgreen「山」; name「山田 はるか」; below「連絡できます」; right quiet「管理者」AND source's small right-pointing chevron at far right (mock omitted it).
Inset neutral dividers align under text columns. Bottom navigation row exact「以前のメンバーを見る」with source-faithful small right chevron; quiet slate text, no extra badge.
MeiryoRegular14/24 names/footer; Regular12/16 status/admin; Bold14/24 initials; all tracking0. Keep logical390x238 compact spacing and same font/weight hierarchy under uniform scale. Name text#1D1D1D, metadata#6E6E6E, supporting icons/chevrons#526173.
Accent decision: original cyan/cream avatar backgrounds are decorative identity differentiation, not presence/role state. Omit colored fills; use white outlined avatars distinguished by existing Japanese initials. Do not invent green online dots or selected states. No primary green-gradient button belongs in this member-list fragment.
Source Add members and Invite via link/QR controls are a DIFFERENT existing catalog component LH03-0018; exclude those rows here. Exclude group screen header, favorites/export/exit/report controls and phone.
Landscape3:2, ONE complete readable component on purewhite canvas, modest margins. Clean familiar source icon geometry, complete Japanese/values2/admin status, no clipping.
reviewNotes: 原画像を検索・役割/状態・進む記号の主参照にし、モックで欠落した他メンバーの右矢印を復元。自分の行には矢印なし。元の水色/クリーム色人物面は識別装飾なので白い輪郭と既存頭文字へ、余計な在席ドットなし。実画像を目視しメンバー2人・あなた/山田 はるか・連絡できます各2・管理者各2・以前のメンバーを見る/矢印・検索を確認。追加/招待は別部品0018として除外。実権限/遷移・書体計測・編集可能性・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
